test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The wizard, while performing an item, accidentally set his own hat on fire and prompted __the fire alarm to go on__.

options.text: the fire alarm to go under
the fire alarm to go away
the fire alarm to go off
the fire alarm to go above

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"go off" **is commonly used to describe alarms starting to make noise.
 
• The other options do not make sense in this context.
